features.name: Provider Credential Completeness Measure
features.description: Scores provider based on completeness and presence of credential fields (degrees, licenses, taxonomy codes) from NPI data as a proxy for profile reliability and legitimacy.
features.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/provider_detail_service.py (NPI Registry CMS API lookup returns credential and taxonomy data)

features.name: Provider Data Freshness Measure
features.description: Scores provider based on recency of NPI record updates (e.g., last updated timestamp) to prioritize actively maintained records.
features.evidence: ASSUMPTION: NPI Registry API includes last updated date field; required to verify in provider_detail_service response schema. GAP: confirm field availability and mapping.

features.name: Clinical Trial Proximity Measure
features.description: Scores trials based on travel distance and duration from user location using Google Routes integration.

features.name: Clinical Trial Recency Measure
features.description: Scores trials based on how recently results were posted or last updated, favoring current and actively maintained studies.
features.evidence: ASSUMPTION: ClinicalTrials.gov API returns last update or results posting date. GAP: confirm field availability in clinical_trials_models or API response.
